bibl.title: A New Demosthenes Fragment From Kellis.
bibl.seg: Klaas A. Worp, A New Demosthenes Fragment From Kellis.
bibl.note: P. Kellis Inv. P00.23 = SCA # 2627, found during the 2000/2001 season in the central village temple area D/7 at level 59. Demosthenes, De Corona 82-83 (recto); 84-85 (verso) on a fourth-century CE codex leaf.
